routes.name: R258-FIELD-ONLY
routes.reason: A quotient can acquire extra boundaries on passing from a faithful module to a division ring. Overfield-only injectivity does not establish induced-module saturation; this is not a counterexample to the original proposition.

C9000258.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 258 (Gersten’s conjecture and virtual compact specialness of one-relator groups.; papers: Baumslag-Solitar-free one-relator groups are hyperbolic; Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C258-ROW.statement: Universal actual-level and incident-slot homology restriction, including coarse rows, over induced coefficients for both primitive forms.

L258-EDGE.statement: All refined edge-to-vertex H1 maps are monomorphisms over faithful coefficient modules, without division in those modules.

L258-LINE.statement: A finite-support line incidence relation supported at one vertex is zero when both endpoint maps are injective.

L258-MACKEY.statement: Mackey-Shapiro identifies all actual double-coset summands and the natural transported inclusion map.

L258-BRIDGE.statement: Both primitive presentations have the stated local Fox maps and an unfolded line; height frames use H^(i)=t^i H t^-i and relator R_-i.

F258-CORE.statement: Universal finite-support line trimming and noncommutative triangular, private-column, and root-frame algebra.
